scripts.prebuild: node scripts/write-cms-runtime-config.mjs && npm run validate:content && npm run validate:i18n && npm run test:cms && npm run test:search && npm run test:ai-guide && npm run test:contact && npm run types:cloudflare:check && npm run check:pages-config && npm run typecheck:functions
scripts.build: astro build && node scripts/validate-search-build.mjs && node scripts/validate-ai-guide-build.mjs && pagefind --site dist && node scripts/build-search-corpus.mjs && node scripts/write-build-meta.mjs
scripts.postbuild: node scripts/enrich-sitemap-i18n.mjs && npm run validate:seo && npm run validate:i18n:dist
scripts.test:search: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/deployment-marker.test.mjs tests/search-api.test.mjs tests/search-corpus.test.mjs tests/search-modal.test.mjs tests/vectorize-sync.test.mjs
scripts.types:cloudflare: wrangler types functions/cloudflare-env.d.ts --env production --env-interface CloudflareEnv --include-runtime false
scripts.types:cloudflare:check: wrangler types functions/cloudflare-env.d.ts --env production --env-interface CloudflareEnv --include-runtime false --check
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name acecore-systems
